title: ꯁꯅꯥ ꯂꯩꯕꯥꯛ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔ
title_en: Sana Leibak Manipur (Golden Land Manipur - State Song of Manipur)
status: Official State Song of Manipur (Adopted by Govt. of Manipur in 2021)
description: The official State Song of Manipur celebrating the scenic natural beauty, sacred Loktak lake, emerald hills, ancestral bravery, and spiritual brotherhood of all communities living in the state.
source: Government of Manipur State Anthem Declaration & Department of Art and Culture Archives
copyright: Official State Cultural Anthem / Public Domain under official state adoption

lyrics.meitei:
ꯁꯅꯥ ꯂꯩꯕꯥꯛ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔ,
ꯀꯣꯂꯣꯏ ꯅꯪꯒꯤ ꯃꯤꯡꯊꯣꯜꯅꯤ,
ꯃꯥꯂꯦꯝ ꯏꯃꯥꯡ ꯈꯪꯅꯔꯕ,
ꯄꯨꯊꯣꯛꯂꯕ ꯅꯪꯒꯤ ꯂꯩꯊꯣꯏꯔꯣꯜ꯫

ꯆꯤꯡꯅ ꯀꯣꯏꯅ ꯄꯥꯡꯕ ꯂꯝ,
ꯍꯥꯎꯅ-ꯃꯩꯇꯩ ꯃꯆꯥꯁꯤꯡ,
ꯏꯆꯦꯜ ꯑꯃꯒꯤ ꯏꯁꯤꯡꯒꯨꯝ,
ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯍꯤꯡꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯤꯕ ꯂꯝ꯫

ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛ ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯏꯊꯛꯅ,
ꯁꯩꯊꯥꯔꯤ ꯅꯪꯒꯤ ꯊꯧꯅꯥꯐꯝ,
ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯥꯏꯆꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯡꯗꯣꯜꯅ,
ꯂꯦꯞꯂꯤ ꯅꯪꯒꯤ ꯏꯀꯥꯏꯈꯨꯝꯅꯕ꯫

ꯑꯩꯈꯣꯏ ꯂꯩꯕꯥꯛ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔ,
ꯁꯅꯥ ꯂꯩꯕꯥꯛ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔ꯫
lyrics.roman:
Sana leibak Manipur,
Koloi nangi mingtholni,
Malem imang khangnaraba,
Puthoklaba nangi leithoirol.

Chingna koina pangba lam,
Haona-Meitei machasing,
Ichel amagi ishing-gum,
Punna hingminnariba lam.

Loktak ishing ithakna,
Seithari nangi thounafam,
Nongmaichinggi chingdolna,
Lepli nangi ikaikhumnaba.

Eikhoi leibak Manipur,
Sana leibak Manipur.
lyrics.bengali:
সনা লৈবাক মণিপুর,
কোলোই নঙ্গী মিংথোল্নী,
মালেম ইমাং খংনরবা,
পুথোক্লবা নঙ্গী লৈথোই রোল।

চিংন কোইন পাংবা লম,
হাওন-মৈতৈ মচাসিং,
ইচেল অমগী ঈশিংগুম,
পুন্ন হিংমিন্নরিব লম।

লোকতাক ঈশিং ইথক্ন,
শৈথারী নঙ্গী থৌনাফম,
নোংমাইচিংগী চিংদোল্ন,
লেপ্লী নঙ্গী ইকাইখুম্নবা।

ঐখোই লৈবাক মণিপুর,
সনা লৈবাক মণিপুর।
lyrics.english:
O Golden Land Manipur,
Such is thy noble renown,
Known throughout the wide world,
Manifesting thy glorious grace.

A land encircled by lofty blue hills,
Where the children of hills and valley,
Like the merged waters of a single river,
Live together in harmonious unity.

Where the rippling waves of Loktak Lake,
Sing eternal praise of thy chivalric valor,
And the sacred peak of Mount Nongmaijing,
Stands as an emblem of thy everlasting dignity.

Our beloved land Manipur,
The Golden Land of Manipur.

title: ꯊꯥꯕꯜ ꯆꯣꯡꯕ ꯏꯁꯩ
title_en: Thabal Chongba Ishei (Spring Moonlight Dance Ballad)
genre: Traditional Spring Dance Ballad / Folk Music
description: The iconic springtime ballad sung during the full-moon nights of Yaoshang (Holi festival). Youth join hands in an open courtyard and dance rhythmically in circles beneath the silver moonlight.
source: Manipuri Folk Music Archives & Traditional Lai Haraoba Oral Records

lyrics.meitei:
ꯊꯥꯕꯜ ꯐꯖꯔꯕ ꯑꯍꯤꯡꯁꯤꯗ,
ꯅꯍꯥ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯂꯥꯛꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯣ,
ꯈꯨꯠꯁꯝꯅꯗꯨꯅ ꯀꯣꯏꯅ ꯆꯣꯡꯁꯤ,
ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯁꯪꯒꯤ ꯅꯨꯡꯉꯥꯏ ꯏꯍꯨꯜꯗ꯫

ꯄꯨꯡꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯂꯥꯎꯅ ꯈꯣꯡꯂꯦ,
ꯙꯣꯂꯛ ꯈꯣꯟꯊꯣꯛꯅ ꯂꯥꯡꯇꯛꯅꯍꯜꯂꯦ,
ꯊꯃꯣꯏ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯍꯔꯥꯎꯔꯦ,
ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯞꯁꯤꯡ ꯄꯨꯟꯁꯤꯟꯔꯦ꯫

ꯅꯤꯡꯊꯤꯔꯕ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗ,
ꯊꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯉꯥꯜ ꯄꯨꯔꯛꯂꯕ ꯃꯇꯝꯗ,
ꯑꯩꯈꯣꯏꯒꯤ ꯆꯠꯅꯕꯤ ꯉꯥꯛꯂꯒ,
ꯆꯍꯤ ꯆꯥꯃ ꯍꯤꯡꯃꯤꯟꯅꯁꯤ꯫
lyrics.roman:
Thabal phajaraba ahingsida,
Naha pumnamak lakminnaro,
Khutsamnaduna koina chongsi,
Yaoshanggi nungngai ihulda.

Punggi maru laona khongle,
Dholak khonthokna langtaknahalle,
Thamoi pumnamak haraore,
Nungsi marupsing punsinre.

Ningthiraba Manipurgi lamda,
Thagi mangal puraklaba matamda,
Eikhoigi chatnabi ngaklaga,
Chahi chama hingminnasi.
lyrics.bengali:
থাবল ফজ্রবা অহিংসীদ,
নহা পুমনমক লাকমিন্নরো,
খুৎশমনদুনা কোইনা চোংশী,
য়াওশংগী নুংঙাই ইহুল্দ।

পুংগী মরূ লাওনা খোংলে,
ঢোলক খোন্থোক্ন লাংতকনহলে,
থমোই পুমনমক হরাওরে,
নুংশী মরুপসিং পুনশিন্রে।

নিংথীরবা মণিপুরগী লম্দ,
থাগী মঙাল পুরক্লবা মতম্দ,
ঐখোইগী চৎনবী ঙাক্লগা,
চহী চামা হিংমিন্নসী।
lyrics.english:
Beneath this radiant moonlight night,
Come gather together, all ye youth,
Holding hands in an encircling dance,
In the ecstatic joy of Yaoshang spring.

The sacred drum resonates through the courtyard,
The cadence of the dholak awakens the pulse,
Every heart overflows with delight,
Bringing together loving companions and friends.

In our enchanted land of Manipur,
Under the silvery illumination of the full moon,
Preserving our sacred ancestral traditions,
May we live united for a hundred peaceful years.

title: ꯑꯩꯈꯣꯏ ꯀꯪꯂꯩꯆꯥ
title_en: Eikhoi Kangleicha (We are the Children of Kangleipak)
description: A stirring ballad invoking the ancient name of Manipur—Kangleipak—recounting the seven ancestral clans (Salai Taret), royal Kangla throne, and sacred Puyas written in Meitei Mayek.
source: Kangleirol Pena Oral Tradition Archives & Manipuri Sahitya Parishad

lyrics.meitei:
ꯑꯩꯈꯣꯏ ꯀꯪꯂꯩꯆꯥꯅꯤ,
ꯏꯄꯨ-ꯏꯄꯥꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯗꯃꯗ,
ꯑꯔꯤꯕ ꯄꯨꯌꯥꯒꯤ ꯃꯉꯥꯜꯅ,
ꯂꯝꯕꯤ ꯇꯥꯛꯂꯤ ꯃꯆꯥꯁꯤꯡꯗ꯫

ꯀꯪꯂꯥ ꯊꯧꯒꯜ ꯇꯧꯔꯕ,
ꯅꯤꯡꯊꯧꯔꯣꯜꯒꯤ ꯄꯨꯋꯥꯔꯤꯗ,
ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡ ꯂꯥꯏꯁꯣꯜ ꯁꯦꯡꯂꯕ,
ꯁꯅꯥꯃꯍꯤꯒꯤ ꯊꯧꯖꯥꯜꯅꯤ꯫

ꯆꯤꯡ-ꯇꯝ ꯃꯇꯦꯡ ꯄꯥꯡꯅꯗꯨꯅ,
ꯏꯆꯤꯟ-ꯏꯅꯥꯎ ꯑꯣꯏꯃꯤꯟꯅꯁꯤ,
ꯑꯩꯈꯣꯏ ꯂꯩꯕꯥꯛ ꯐꯒꯠꯅꯕ,
ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯁꯨꯃꯤꯟꯅꯁꯤ꯫
lyrics.roman:
Eikhoi Kangleichani,
Ipu-ipagi lamdamda,
Ariba Puyagi mangalna,
Lambi takli machasingda.

Kangla thougal touraba,
Ningthourolgi puwarida,
Laining-laisol senglaba,
Sanamahigi thoujalni.

Ching-tam mateng pangnaduna,
Ichin-inao oiminnasi,
Eikhoi leibak fagatnaba,
Punna thabak suminnasi.
lyrics.bengali:
ঐখোই কংলাইচানী,
ইপু-ইপাগী লমদম্দ,
অরিবা পুয়াগী মঙাল্ন,
লম্বী তাক্লী মচাসিংদ।

কংলা থৌগল তৌরবা,
নিংথৌরোলগী পুওয়ারীদ,
লাইনিং-লাইশোল শেংলবা,
সনামহিগী থৌজাল্নী।

চিং-তম মতেং পাংনদুনা,
ইচিন-ইনাও ওইমিন্নসী,
ঐখোই লৈবাক ফগৎনবা,
পুন্ন থবক শুমিন্নসী।
lyrics.english:
We are the proud children of Kangleipak,
Living in this sacred realm of our ancestors,
Where the eternal light of ancient Puyas,
Illuminates the righteous way for all future children.

From the venerated halls of ancient Kangla,
Echoing through the annals of kings,
And through sacred rites of faith,
Flow the benevolent blessings of Lainingthou Sanamahi.

Hills and valleys standing together hand in hand,
Living in peace as loving siblings,
To foster prosperity and dignity for our land,
Let us work together with one heart and soul.

title: ꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯁꯥꯠꯄꯤ ꯑꯦꯡꯉꯦꯜꯂꯩ
title_en: Chingda Satpi Engellei (The Wild Blossom of the Mountain Peak)
description: One of Manipur's most beloved lyrical folk songs comparing modest pure devotion to the wild orchid blooming unseen upon the mist-shrouded mountain peaks.
source: Manipuri Folk Music Archives & All India Radio Imphal Archives

lyrics.meitei:
ꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯁꯥꯠꯄꯤ ꯑꯦꯡꯉꯦꯜꯂꯩ,
ꯀꯅꯥꯒꯤꯗꯃꯛ ꯂꯩꯔꯥꯡ ꯁꯥꯠꯂꯤꯕꯅꯤ,
ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯞꯀꯤ ꯊꯃꯣꯏꯅꯤ꯫

ꯅꯣꯡꯂꯩ-ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯠꯅ ꯁꯤꯠꯂꯕꯁꯨ,
ꯅꯪꯒꯤ ꯃꯒꯨꯟ ꯃꯥꯡꯗꯅ ꯂꯩꯔꯤ,
ꯃꯥꯂꯦꯝ ꯃꯄꯨꯡ ꯐꯖꯅꯕ,
ꯆꯤꯡꯗꯣꯜ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯉꯥꯟꯊꯣꯛꯂꯤ꯫
lyrics.roman:
Chingda satpi engellei,
Kanagidamak leirang satlibani,
Nungsi marupki thamoini.

Nonglei-nungsitna sitlabasu,
Nangi magun mangdana leiri,
Malem mapung phajanaba,
Chingdol mathakta nganthokli.
lyrics.bengali:
চিংদ শাৎপী এঙেল্লৈ,
কনাগীদমক লৈরাং শাৎলিবনী,
নুংশী মরুপকী থমোইনী।

নোংলৈ-নুংশিৎন শিৎলবাসু,
নঙ্গী মগুন মাংদন লৈরী,
মালেম মপুং ফজনবা,
চিংদোল মথক্ত ঙান্থোক্লী।
lyrics.english:
O wild blossom blooming upon the mountain height,
For whom dost thou unfold thy tender petals?
It is for the beloved companion of the heart.

Though stormy tempests blow across the ridge,
Thy sweet grace and fragrance never fade,
Adorning the broad earth with splendour,
Radiating high atop the lofty peak.

title: ꯇꯝꯅ ꯁꯥꯡꯕ ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛ ꯄꯥꯠ
title_en: Tamna Sangba Loktak Pat (The Emerald Waters of Loktak Lake)
description: A lyric ode honoring Loktak Lake, its floating phumdis, the sacred Sendra promontory, and the Sangai browsing in the Keibul Lamjao sanctuary.
source: Moirang Kangleirol Archives & Loktak Folk Songs Collection

lyrics.meitei:
ꯇꯝꯅ ꯁꯥꯡꯕ ꯂꯣꯛꯇꯥꯛ ꯄꯥꯠ,
ꯏꯁꯤꯡ ꯏꯊꯛꯅ ꯅꯨꯡꯉꯥꯏꯍꯟꯕ,
ꯐꯨꯝꯗꯤ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ ꯍꯤ ꯊꯧꯔꯛꯄ,
ꯉꯥꯃꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯞꯀꯤ ꯏꯁꯩꯅꯤ꯫

ꯁꯦꯟꯗ꯭ꯔꯥ ꯆꯤꯡꯗ ꯂꯦꯞꯇꯨꯅ ꯌꯦꯡꯕꯗ,
ꯄꯥꯠꯀꯤ ꯃꯑꯣꯡ ꯐꯖꯔꯦ,
ꯀꯩꯕꯨꯜ ꯂꯝꯖꯥꯎꯒꯤ ꯁꯥꯉꯥꯏꯅ,
ꯂꯩꯄꯥꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯕꯨ ꯉꯥꯛꯂꯤ꯫
lyrics.roman:
Tamna sangba Loktak pat,
Ishing ithakna nungngaihanba,
Phumdi mathakta hi thouramba,
Ngami marupki isheini.

Sendra chingda leptuna yengbada,
Patki maong phajare,
Keibul Lamjaogi sangaina,
Leipak asibu ngakli.
lyrics.bengali:
তম্ন শাংবা লোকতাক পাৎ,
ঈশিং ইথক্ন নুংঙাইহনবা,
ফুমদী মথক্ত হী থৌরম্বা,
ঙামী মরুপকী ঈশৈনী।

সেন্দ্রা চিংদ লেপতুনা য়েংবদা,
পাৎকী মওং ফজরে,
কৈবুল লমজাওগী সাঙাইনা,
লৈবাক অসিবু ঙাক্লী।
lyrics.english:
O emerald expanse of Loktak Lake,
Thy dancing water waves bring solace to the soul,
As wooden canoes glide amidst floating phumdis,
The fishermen sing their timeless song.

Beholding the waters from Mount Sendra,
The beauty of the lake fills the heart with wonder,
Where the dancing Sangai in Keibul Lamjao,
Guards the sacred heritage of our land.

title: ꯃꯣꯏꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯪꯂꯩꯔꯣꯜ ꯁꯩꯁꯛ
title_en: Moirang Kangleirol Seisak (The Ballad of Khamba and Thoibi)
genre: Epic Pena Ballad / Moirang Oral Tradition
description: The traditional bardic ballad sung with the sacred Pena lute narrating the chivalric romance of Khuman Khamba and princess Thoibi of Moirang.
source: Moirang Kangleirol Archives & Manipuri Sahitya Parishad

lyrics.meitei:
ꯏꯄꯨꯊꯧ ꯊꯥꯡꯖꯤꯡ ꯈꯨꯔꯨꯝꯖꯔꯤ,
ꯃꯣꯏꯔꯥꯡ ꯀꯪꯂꯩꯔꯣꯜꯒꯤ ꯁꯩꯁꯛꯅꯤ,
ꯈꯝꯕ ꯊꯣꯏꯕꯤ ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯕꯒꯤ,
ꯋꯥꯔꯤ ꯑꯁꯤ ꯃꯥꯂꯦꯝꯗ ꯈꯪꯅꯔꯦ꯫

ꯇꯣꯔꯕꯨꯡ ꯂꯝꯄꯥꯛꯇ ꯀꯥꯑꯣ ꯐꯥꯕ,
ꯈꯝꯕꯒꯤ ꯊꯧꯅꯥ ꯎꯠꯂꯕ,
ꯊꯣꯏꯕꯤ ꯅꯤꯡꯉꯣꯜꯒꯤ ꯊꯃꯣꯏꯅ,
ꯈꯝꯕꯕꯨ ꯊꯋꯥꯏ ꯀꯠꯈꯤ꯫
lyrics.roman:
Iputhou Thangjing khurumjari,
Moirang Kangleirolgi seisakni,
Khamba Thoibi nungsibagi,
Wari asi malemda khangnare.

Torbung lampakta kao phaba,
Khambagi thouna utlaba,
Thoibi ningolgi thamoina,
Khambabu thawai kat-khi.
lyrics.bengali:
ইপুথৌ থাংজিং খুরুমজরী,
মোইরাং কংলাই রোলগী শৈশক্নি,
খম্বা থোইবী নুংশীবগী,
ওয়ারী অসী মালেম্দ খংনরে।

তোরবুং লম্পাক্ত কাও ফাবা,
খম্বাগী থৌনা উৎলবা,
থোইবী নিংঙোলগী থমোইনা,
খম্বাবু থৱাই কৎখী।
lyrics.english:
Homage to Lord Thangjing of Moirang,
We sing the epic ballad of ancient Moirang,
The sacred love of Khamba and Thoibi,
Celebrated throughout the world.

Taming the wild Kao bull on Torbung field,
Khamba displayed his fearless valor,
While princess Thoibi in her heart,
Consecrated her eternal soul to him.

title: ꯍꯦ ꯂꯩꯄꯥꯛꯄꯣꯛꯄ
title_en: He Leipakpokpa (O Creator of the Motherland)
composer: Ancient Maibi Priestesses and Amaiba Scholars
description: An ancient sacred cosmological hymn invoking Lainingthou Sanamahi and the Umang Lai deities, chanting for prosperity, peace, and divine protection of all people in Manipur.
source: Sanamahi Laining Laisol Manuscripts & Manipur Temple Archives

lyrics.meitei:
ꯍꯦ ꯂꯩꯄꯥꯛꯄꯣꯛꯄ ꯏꯄꯨꯊꯧ,
ꯁꯅꯥꯃꯍꯤ ꯅꯪꯒꯤ ꯊꯧꯖꯥꯜꯅ,
ꯃꯥꯂꯦꯝ ꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯊꯨꯡꯅ ꯃꯉꯥꯜ ꯄꯤꯔꯤ,
ꯑꯩꯈꯣꯏ ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯄꯨ ꯉꯥꯛ-ꯁꯦꯟꯕꯤꯌꯨ꯫

ꯀꯪꯂꯥ ꯀꯣꯅꯨꯡꯒꯤ ꯂꯥꯏꯅꯤꯡ ꯁꯦꯡꯂꯕ,
ꯑꯔꯤꯕ ꯄꯨꯌꯥꯒꯤ ꯋꯥꯐꯝ ꯉꯥꯛꯂꯒ,
ꯙꯔꯃ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯁꯇ꯭ꯌꯒꯤ ꯂꯝꯕꯤꯗ,
ꯃꯇꯝ ꯆꯨꯞꯄꯗ ꯂꯨꯆꯤꯡꯕꯤꯌꯨ꯫
lyrics.roman:
He Leipakpokpa Iputhou,
Sanamahi nangi thoujalna,
Malem sinba thungna mangal piri,
Eikhoi pumnamakpu ngak-senbiyu.

Kangla konunggi laining senglaba,
Ariba Puyagi wafam ngaklaga,
Dharma amasung satyagi lambida,
Matam chuppada luchingbiyu.
lyrics.bengali:
হে লৈবাকপোকপা ইপুথৌ,
সনামহী নঙ্গী থৌজাল্ন,
মালেম শিন্বা থুংন মঙাল পীরী,
ঐখোই পুমনমকপু ঙাক-শেন্বীয়ু।

কংলা কোনুংগী লাইনিং শেংলবা,
অরিবা পুয়াগী ৱাফম ঙাক্লগা,
ধর্ম অমসুং সত্যগী লম্বীদ,
মতম চুপ্পদ লুচিংবীয়ু।
lyrics.english:
O Divine Progenitor of the Earth and Realm,
Lord Sanamahi, through Thy divine benevolence,
Light is bestowed across the universe,
Protect and safeguard all Thy children.

Preserving the pure faith of Kangla Palace,
Honoring the sacred wisdom of ancient Puyas,
Upon the path of Dharma and eternal Truth,
Lead us forward through all ages.

title: ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯥꯏꯖꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯡꯃꯩ
title_en: Nongmaijinggi Chingmei (Dawn Light on Mount Nongmaijing)
description: A classical lyric praising Mount Nongmaijing where the sun first dawns in Manipur, celebrating Lord Marjing, the mythological origin of Sagol Kangjei (Polo), and the winged white steed Samadon Ayangba.
source: Marjing Laisol Archives & Manipur Polo Heritage Records

lyrics.meitei:
ꯅꯣꯡꯃꯥꯏꯖꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯆꯤꯡꯗꯣꯜ ꯃꯊꯛꯇ,
ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯃꯉꯥꯜꯅ ꯉꯥꯟꯊꯣꯛꯂꯦ,
ꯏꯄꯨꯊꯧ ꯃꯥꯔꯖꯤꯡ ꯂꯥꯏꯔꯦꯟ,
ꯁꯒꯣꯜ ꯀꯥꯡꯖꯩꯒꯤ ꯏꯄꯨꯅꯤ꯫

ꯁꯃꯗꯣꯟ ꯑꯌꯥꯡꯕꯒꯤ ꯈꯣꯡꯊꯥꯡꯅ,
ꯃꯥꯂꯦꯝ ꯃꯤꯌꯥꯝꯕꯨ ꯍꯔꯥꯎꯍꯜꯂꯦ,
ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔꯒꯤ ꯁꯒꯣꯜ ꯊꯧꯅꯥ,
ꯃꯥꯂꯦꯝ ꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯊꯨꯡꯅ ꯁꯟꯗꯣꯛꯂꯦ꯫
lyrics.roman:
Nongmaijinggi chingdol mathakta,
Numit mangalna nganthokle,
Iputhou Marjing lairen,
Sagol kangjeigi ipuni.

Samadon Ayangbagi khongthangna,
Malem miyambu haraohalle,
Manipurgi sagol thouna,
Malem sinba thungna sandokle.
lyrics.bengali:
নোংমাইজিংগী চিংদোল মথক্ত,
নুমিৎ মঙাল্ন ঙান্থোক্লে,
ইপুথৌ মারজিং লাইরেন,
সগোল কাংজৈগী ইপুনী।

সমদোন অয়াংবগী খোংথাংন,
মালেম মীয়াম্বু হরাওহলে,
মণিপুরগী সগোল থৌনা,
মালেম শিন্বা থুংন শন্দোক্লে।
lyrics.english:
High atop the sacred summit of Mount Nongmaijing,
The golden dawn sun radiates its pristine beams,
Where dwells the supreme deity Lord Marjing,
Father and patron of equestrian polo.

With the winged gallop of the celestial steed Samadon,
Bringing delight and glory to humanity,
The equestrian chivalry of Manipur,
Resounds throughout the entire world.

title: ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯔꯕꯤ ꯑꯩꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔ
title_en: Nungshirabi Eigi Manipur (My Beloved Land Manipur)
description: A popular patriotic choral anthem expressing deep love for Manipur, praising the harmony of the hills and valleys, green fields, and industrious culture.
source: Department of Art and Culture, Manipur & AIR Imphal Archives

lyrics.meitei:
ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯔꯕꯤ ꯑꯩꯒꯤ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔ,
ꯆꯤꯡ-ꯇꯝ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯂꯩꯃꯤꯟꯅꯔꯤ,
ꯁꯥꯡꯂꯕ ꯂꯧꯕꯨꯛ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯄꯥꯠꯅ,
ꯅꯪꯕꯨ ꯅꯤꯡꯊꯤꯅ ꯁꯦꯝꯂꯤ꯫

ꯏꯆꯤꯟ-ꯏꯅꯥꯎꯒꯨꯝ ꯅꯨꯡꯁꯤꯅꯗꯨꯅ,
ꯂꯩꯄꯥꯛ ꯑꯁꯤꯕꯨ ꯆꯥꯎꯈꯠꯍꯟꯁꯤ,
ꯁꯇ꯭ꯌ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯙꯔꯃ ꯉꯥꯛꯂꯒ,
ꯃꯇꯝ ꯆꯨꯞꯄꯗ ꯃꯥꯏꯄꯥꯛꯂꯁꯤ꯫
lyrics.roman:
Nungshirabi eigi Manipur,
Ching-tam punna leiminnari,
Sanglaba laubuk amasung patna,
Nangbu ningthina semli.

Ichin-inaogum nungsinaduna,
Leipak asibu chaokhathanse,
Satya amasung dharma ngaklaga,
Matam chuppada maipaklasi.
lyrics.bengali:
নুংশীরবী ঐগী মণিপুর,
চিং-তম পুন্ন লৈমিন্নরী,
শাংলবা লৌবুক অমসুং পাৎন,
নঙ্গী নিংথীন শেম্লী।

ইচিন-ইনাওগুম নুংশীনদুনা,
লৈবাক অসিবু চাউখৎহনসী,
সত্য অমসুং ধর্ম ঙাক্লগা,
মতম চুপ্পদ মাইপাক্লসী।
lyrics.english:
My dearly beloved Manipur,
Where hills and valleys live together as one,
Verdant paddy fields and clear waters,
Adorn thee in exquisite elegance.

Loving one another as true brothers and sisters,
Let us bring prosperity to our beloved land,
Upholding righteousness and truth,
May we triumph through all ages.

title: ꯈꯨꯂꯥꯡ ꯑꯦꯁꯩ: ꯂꯧꯔꯣꯛ ꯏꯁꯩ
title_en: Khulang Eshei (The Golden Harvest Song of the Valley)
genre: Traditional Harvest Folk Song / Agrarian Ballad
description: A rhythmic communal harvest song sung by men and women reaping golden paddy across the fields of the Manipur valley during autumn.
source: Agricultural Folklore of Manipur & Traditional Folk Song Collections

lyrics.meitei:
ꯂꯧꯕꯨꯛ ꯁꯤꯟꯕ ꯊꯨꯡꯅ ꯁꯅꯥꯒꯨꯝ,
ꯐꯧꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯨ ꯆꯥꯎꯅ ꯃꯟꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯩꯔꯦ,
ꯂꯧꯃꯤ ꯃꯔꯨꯞꯁꯤꯡ ꯂꯥꯛꯂꯣ ꯍꯥꯌꯅ,
ꯈꯨꯠꯇ ꯊꯥꯡꯒꯣꯜ ꯄꯥꯏꯗꯨꯅ ꯂꯥꯛꯂꯦ꯫

ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯃꯉꯥꯜꯅ ꯂꯧꯕꯨꯛ ꯉꯥꯟꯍꯜꯂꯦ,
ꯍꯔꯥꯎꯕ ꯏꯁꯩ ꯄꯨꯟꯅ ꯁꯛꯁꯤ,
ꯆꯍꯤ ꯑꯁꯤꯒꯤ ꯐꯧ-ꯆꯦꯡ ꯌꯥꯝꯂꯦ,
ꯏꯃꯨꯡ ꯈꯨꯗꯤꯡꯃꯛ ꯄꯦꯟꯍꯟꯒꯅꯤ꯫
lyrics.roman:
Laubuk sinba thungna sanagum,
Phougi maru chaona manduna leire,
Loumi marupsing laklo hayna,
Khutta thangol paiduna lakle.

Numit mangalna laubuk nganhalle,
Haraoba ishei punna saksi,
Chahi asigi phou-cheng yamle,
Imung khudingmak penhangani.
lyrics.bengali:
লৌবুক শিন্বা থুংন সনাগুম,
ফৌগী মরূ চাউনা মিন্দুনা লৈরে,
লৌমী মরুপসিং লাক্লো হায়না,
খুৎত থাংগোল পাইদুনা লাকলে।

নুমিৎ মঙাল্ন লৌবুক ঙানহলে,
হরাওবা ঈশৈ পুন্ন শক্সী,
চহী অসীগী ফৌ-চেং য়াম্লে,
ইমুং খুদিংমক পেন্হনগনী।
lyrics.english:
Across the vast paddy fields like shining gold,
The heavy ears of paddy bend with bountiful grain,
Calling all farming companions to gather,
With curved sickles held ready in hand.

The autumn sun bathes the plains in light,
Let us sing our joyous harvest song together,
Abundant is this year's harvest of rice,
Bringing sustenance and contentment to every home.
